changes: Retain original MemoView article/pinned layout, MemoHeader timestamp+Tooltip, MemoBody, ClampedSection measurement/fade/toggle, MemoContentView and MemoMarkdown renderer, original tag and heading/navigation algorithms.

This is a read-only local three-memo timeline, not Home service or full Memos: fictional texts, empty attachments/relations/reactions, no current user, no creator/avatar/media; only local tag filtering and permalink view. Parent/card rendering style is original.

Explicit empty/disabled service branches: EditSession, upload/audio/draft/publish, reactions, action menus, comments, space/avatar/share dialogs. No empty placeholders or fake success controls displayed. No user input or claimed editing workflow.

Original MemoEditor view branch retained in a small read-only facade; edit requests fail closed. Local useMemoByName returns fixture state, query/auth/router hooks are an in-memory adapter, not fake HTTP.

The fixture excludes HTML, math, Mermaid, code highlighting, images and outgoing links. Their async engines are removed; no alternate math/parser/diagram rendering. Original editor/parser and tag/mention/footnote mechanisms remain; URL resolver returns null and HTML sanitizer returns no nodes.

Original theme and full application CSS compiled with original @usememos/ui/editor package CSS. No webfonts/images downloaded; original font stacks fallback. Original inline SVG CSS checkmarks and original engine icons retained, with embedded Lucide attribution.
No browser storage or network; hidden tasks pause, owned listeners/timers/RAF are cleared on exit. Original toolkit geometry and visual layout not browser-validated.
Exact editor26.11.0/ui26.11.9/base-ui1.9.0 match source. React19.3.1, Lucide-react1.70.0, Tailwind4.3.0 are installed compatible versions rather than pretending full original lock resolution.
publication: 7 files only. Full originals/adapted source/tests remain in local workspace; no source archive claimed.
